CREATE PROC [OM].[SP_SRC_CHECK] @task_name [varchar](100),@process_date [datetime] AS
BEGIN

    DECLARE @FLAG_CNT [NUMERIC](15,0)
    DECLARE @ME_FLAG_CNT [NUMERIC](15,0)
	
	SELECT  
		@ME_FLAG_CNT=COUNT(*)  
	FROM 
		[EDS].[DATE_DIM] 
	WHERE 
		FULLDATE=@process_date 
		AND COALESCE(MONTH_END,'N')='Y'

SELECT * FROM OM.OM_TASKS WHERE TABLE_TYPE = 'SNAPSHOT' AND DATA_LAYER = 'EDS' AND TASK_NAME = 'TSK_EDS_LOANS_FACT'
INSERT INTO OM.OM_TASK_RUN
SELECT * FROM OM.OM_TASK_RUN WHERE DATA_LAYER = 'EDS' AND TASK_NAME = 'TSK_EDS_LOANS_FACT'


SELECT * FROM OM.OM_TASK_RUN  WHERE  TASK_NAME IN ('TSK_STG_EDS_DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTERFULL','TSK_BNKM_GLD_CURRENCYCONVERSION','TSK_STG_EDS_DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES','TSK_STG_EDS_DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCEFULL','TSK_EDS_DEP_TDMASTER','TSK_EDS_DEP_CASAMASTER')
SELECT * FROM [OM].[OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY] OTD WHERE OTD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME = 'TSK_EDS_DEPOSIT_FACT'


	DECLARE @process_date DATE, @task_name VARCHAR(100)
	SET @process_date = '2023-09-01'
	SET @task_name = 'TSK_EDS_DEPOSIT_FACT'

    SELECT
	--@FLAG_CNT=(CASE WHEN COUNT(*) <> SUM(COALESCE((CASE WHEN OS.STATUS = 'SUCCESSFUL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0)) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
	COUNT(*)
	,SUM(COALESCE((CASE WHEN OS.STATUS = 'SUCCESSFUL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0))
	FROM 
		[OM].[OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY] OTD
	LEFT JOIN
		[OM].[OM_TASK_RUN] OTR
		ON
		OTD.TASK_NAME =  OTR.TASK_NAME AND
		OTR.PROCESS_DATE = @process_date
	LEFT JOIN   
		[OM].[OM_STATUS] OS
		ON
		OTR.STATUS_ID =  OS.STATUS_ID
	WHERE
		OTD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME = UPPER(@task_name)
		AND COALESCE(OTD.MONTHEND,'N')<>'Y'
	GROUP BY
		OTD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME

		SELECT * FROM [OM].[OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY] OTD WHERE OTD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME = 'TSK_EDS_DEP_SERVICEOUTLETTABLE'
	 
	IF(@FLAG_CNT<>1)   
		BEGIN
			DECLARE @errmsg1 NVARCHAR(2048) = 'JOB '+@task_name+' SOURCES ARE NOT YET AVAILABLE, PLEASE CHECK OM.OM_TASK_RUN TABLE FOR LIST OF SOURCES THAT ARE NOT YET AVAILABLE';   
	  
			THROW 80000, @errmsg1, 1;  
		END
		
	IF(@ME_FLAG_CNT>0)   
		BEGIN
			SELECT
			@FLAG_CNT=(CASE WHEN COUNT(*) <> SUM(COALESCE((CASE WHEN OS.STATUS = 'SUCCESSFUL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0)) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
			
			FROM 
				[OM].[OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY] OTD
			LEFT JOIN
				[OM].[OM_TASK_RUN] OTR
				ON
				OTD.TASK_NAME =  OTR.TASK_NAME AND
				OTR.PROCESS_DATE = @process_date
			LEFT JOIN   
				[OM].[OM_STATUS] OS
				ON
				OTR.STATUS_ID =  OS.STATUS_ID
			WHERE
				OTD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME = UPPER(@task_name)
				AND COALESCE(OTD.MONTHEND,'N')='Y'
			GROUP BY
				OTD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME
		
				IF(@FLAG_CNT<>1)   
				BEGIN
					DECLARE @errmsg2 NVARCHAR(2048) = 'JOB '+@task_name+' SOURCES ARE NOT YET AVAILABLE, PLEASE CHECK OM.OM_TASK_RUN TABLE FOR LIST OF SOURCES THAT ARE NOT YET AVAILABLE';   
			  
					THROW 80000, @errmsg2, 1;  
				END
		END	

END
GO
